title: feat(registry): enable persistence by default
body:
Makes `persistence.enabled: true` the default so the registry keeps pushed images across restarts (PVC at `/var/lib/registry`, 20Gi). Set `persistence.enabled=false` for ephemeral, or use `REGISTRY_STORAGE_*` object storage.

Bumps chart 0.1.0 → 0.1.1; README updated.

⚠️ Upgrading a release that ran **without** persistence creates a fresh PVC and mounts it — images held only in the ephemeral container layer aren't carried over (they were lost on any restart regardless).
